references.text: Parallel in the confession of sin against innocent blood, with a contrast between Reuben's warning about accountability and Judah's encounter with indifference.
Direct continuation of the same event; shows Reuben's consistent attempt to save Joseph and avoid bloodguilt.
Thematic parallel on how actions against the innocent create collective guilt over the entire people.
Direct precursor to the event; shows Reuben's original warning which he refers to in Gen 42:22.
Shorter version of the same event; confirms that the warning not to shed blood was indeed given.
